notes.title: Patch Release Notice (6/3)
notes.content:
The bug affecting the controller analog stick has been fixed.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

notes.title: 6/2 Update Bugs
notes.content:
A bug that affects the analog stick in today's (6/2) update has been discovered. We are currently working to resolve this issue in the update scheduled for tomorrow.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. Your understanding is appreciated.

notes.title: Patch Release Notice (6/2)
notes.content:
The bug preventing changes to controller button settings from taking effect has been fixed.
With this update, any action can now be set to each button. When changing the button settings, please ensure that all actions required for gameplay are taken into account before launching the game.

notes.title: Patch Release Notice(May 27)
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that the setting tool is repeatedly started when the config file is failed to load.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: Patch Release Notice (5/26)
notes.content:
The bug causing game settings to not save correctly under certain circumstances, preventing the game from launching, has been fixed.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
